title: Data Structure Visualizer (Lessons + Playground + Algorithm Animations)

requirements.summary: Create core multi-page site structure with clear client-side navigation (Home, Data Structures, Algorithms, Playground, About).
acceptanceCriteria: A top-level navigation is present on all pages and works without reloads.
Each page has a clear header and content area and is responsive on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Create the app shell with client-side routing for Home, Data Structures, Algorithms, Playground, About, and a Not Found route; ensure navigation occurs without page reloads.

Create a shared layout with a persistent header/nav and main content container used on all pages. Use the shadcn-ui component library to provide consistent navigation and header controls. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the Home page content (hero, quick links to main sections) and ensure it renders within the shared layout; wire in generated assets at frontend/public/assets/generated/dsvis-logo.dim_512x512.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/dsvis-hero.dim_1600x600.png.
Create the Data Structures page that hosts the Concept Lessons browsing/selection experience and demo panel container.
Create the Algorithms page that hosts sorting and graph traversal visualizations with shared animation controls.
Create the interactive Playground page for manipulating selected data structures with controls and visualization area.
Create an About page describing the tool and how to use lessons/playground/animations.
Create a simple Not Found page and ensure it is reachable via the router for unknown routes.

requirements.summary: Implement a consistent, neat student-focused visual theme (typography, spacing, colors, and component styling) across all pages.
acceptanceCriteria: All pages share the same typography scale, spacing system, and component styling.
Layout remains readable and uncluttered at common breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop).

file_operations.description: Add global styling entry point with Tailwind base layers and a consistent design system (CSS variables for colors, typography defaults, spacing rhythm), aligned to the existing Tailwind + shadcn-ui token approach.
Adjust/confirm theme configuration (container, typography plugin usage, and color token mappings) to support the site-wide educational theme and consistent breakpoints.

Apply consistent layout spacing and typography to header/footer/main container. Use shadcn-ui layout primitives (e.g., Card/Separator) where appropriate to unify styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Build a Concept Lessons experience for the minimum set of data structures with consistent lesson sections and a paired visual demo panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can select a data structure and see an overview explanation plus a live visualization panel.
At least the listed data structures have lesson pages/sections with consistent structure (Overview, Operations, Complexity, Common pitfalls).

file_operations.description: Implement the Concept Lessons UI: topic selector, lesson content panel with consistent sections (Overview, Operations, Complexity, Common pitfalls), and a paired visual demo panel that updates per selection. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Tabs/Accordion/Card) to keep lesson structure consistent. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a reusable lesson viewer that renders curated lesson text into structured sections and coordinates a selected visualization demo panel.

Create a sidebar/list for selecting among the minimum data structure topics (Array, Linked List, Stack, Queue, Binary Search Tree, Heap, Graph). Use shadcn-ui navigation/list components for clear selection states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a demo panel that hosts the appropriate visualization (array/linked list/stack/queue/BST/heap/graph) and can run a small illustrative scenario tied to the lesson selection.
Create an Array visualization component used by lessons and playground; support highlighting indices and showing captions per step.
Create a Linked List visualization component with node boxes and pointer/next indicators; support highlighting active nodes and pointer movement per step.
Create a Stack visualization component showing push/pop with top highlight and step captions.
Create a Queue visualization component showing enqueue/dequeue with head/tail markers and step captions.
Create a Binary Search Tree visualization component with node highlighting for comparisons, insertion path, and traversal steps.
Create a Heap visualization component (array + tree view as needed) supporting swap highlights and heapify steps.
Create a Graph visualization component with node/edge highlighting, visited styling, and frontier/stack display integration for traversals.

requirements.summary: Create an interactive Playground to manipulate selected data structures with common operations, reset, and load-sample actions plus input validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Playground supports interactive operations for each implemented data structure type with immediate visual feedback.
Playground provides Reset and Load Sample actions and validates user input (e.g., numeric ranges, required fields).

file_operations.description: Implement the Playground UI: data structure selector, operation controls, visualization area, and panels for Reset and Load Sample actions. Use shadcn-ui form components (Select/Input/Button) to keep controls neat and consistent. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create reusable operation controls that adapt per selected data structure (insert/delete/search/peek/pop/enqueue/dequeue, etc.), including validation and disabled states.

Create a Load Sample UI that lists presets for the selected topic and applies them to the playground state. Use shadcn-ui components for list/dialog/picker UX. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add front-end-only engines for each data structure that apply operations to state and emit visualization steps (for immediate visual feedback and animation).
Extend the demo panel to support the playground mode (render current state + step highlights) for each implemented data structure.

requirements.summary: Add step-by-step animation controls (Play/Pause, Step Forward, optional Step Back, Speed) with clear step captions and highlighting.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can control animation playback and speed for operations.
Visual state clearly highlights what changed (e.g., compared nodes, moved pointers, swapped elements) with a short caption per step.

file_operations.description: Create a shared step/animation controller (timeline of steps, play/pause, step forward/back, speed control) usable by all visualizations without duplicating logic.

Create a consistent control bar with Play/Pause, Step Forward, optional Step Back, and Speed slider; include accessible labels and tooltips. Use shadcn-ui components (Button/Slider/Tooltip) to standardize controls. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a small caption/status component that displays the current step description and non-color indicators (e.g., labels) for what is highlighted.
Wire the shared stepper and AnimationControls into the data-structure demo panel so operations can be animated step-by-step with captions and highlighting.
Wire the shared stepper and AnimationControls into algorithm visualizations so they follow the same interaction model as data structures.

requirements.summary: Implement algorithm visualizations (Bubble/Insertion sort, BFS/DFS) using the same step/animation controls and clear highlighting.
acceptanceCriteria: Sorting visualizations show array state changes over time with highlighted comparisons/swaps.
BFS/DFS visualizations show visited order and frontier/stack behavior with node/edge highlighting.

file_operations.description: Implement the Algorithms page UI with sections for Sorting (Bubble, Insertion) and Graph Traversal (BFS, DFS); ensure each visualization is selectable and uses the shared animation controls.
Create a Bubble Sort visualization producing step sequences with array state snapshots, highlighted comparisons/swaps, and per-step captions.
Create an Insertion Sort visualization producing step sequences with key selection, shifts/inserts highlighted, and per-step captions.
Create a combined BFS/DFS visualization that produces step sequences showing visited order and frontier/stack behavior, with node/edge highlighting and captions.
Extend GraphViz to support traversal-specific highlighting (visited, active, frontier/stack membership) in a way that remains understandable without relying on color alone.

requirements.summary: Integrate frontend with backend using React Query to load lesson content and example presets with loading and error UI states.
acceptanceCriteria: Lesson/preset data is fetched through React Query with caching.
Users see clear skeleton/loading states and a readable error message with a retry action when calls fail.

file_operations.description: Create a small typed backend client wrapper that uses the project’s core-infrastructure backend connection configuration to call the generated canister actor methods defined in frontend/src/backend.d.ts. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create React Query hooks for loading topics and topic details with caching, refetch control, and stable query keys.
Create React Query hooks for loading lessons for a topic and mapping lesson content into the Concept Lessons viewer model.
Create React Query hooks for loading example presets for a topic and exposing them to the Playground sample loader.

Create a reusable loading UI (including skeletons where appropriate). Use shadcn-ui Skeleton components to provide consistent loading placeholders. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable error UI that shows a readable message and a Retry action button. Use shadcn-ui Alert/Button components for consistent styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire React Query hooks to load topics/lessons and show LoadingState/ErrorState with retry; remove hardcoded lesson dependencies in the Concept Lessons UI.
Wire React Query hooks to load presets by selected topic and show LoadingState/ErrorState with retry in the sample preset flow.

requirements.summary: Ensure the UI is accessible and classroom-friendly (keyboard operability, contrast, readable sizes, and clear empty states/tooltips).
acceptanceCriteria: All playground controls are reachable via keyboard and have accessible labels.
Text and key visualization colors meet reasonable contrast and remain understandable without relying on color alone (e.g., add shapes/outlines/labels).

file_operations.description: Ensure header navigation is keyboard operable, includes visible focus states, and uses semantic landmarks (header/nav/main) with skip-to-content support where appropriate.

Add accessible labels (aria-label/aria-describedby), keyboard-friendly interaction patterns, validation messaging, and clear empty states/tooltips for each operation control. Use shadcn-ui Tooltip to explain controls succinctly. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure all animation buttons and the speed slider are keyboard reachable, have accessible names, and provide tooltips/help text; ensure focus order is logical. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Refine global font sizing, line-height, and focus ring styling; tune color tokens for sufficient contrast and avoid conveying meaning by color alone (support outlines/labels in visualization styles).
Add non-color cues for highlights (e.g., outlines, badges/labels for active index) and ensure text remains readable at common breakpoints.
Add non-color cues for highlights (e.g., thicker borders, pointer labels) and ensure keyboard users can understand current step via caption updates.
Add non-color cues for active comparisons/path (e.g., outline patterns/labels) to keep steps understandable for color-blind users.
Add non-color cues for swap/compare states (e.g., outlines and step labels) and ensure small screens remain readable.
Add distinct shapes/outlines/labels for visited/active/frontier nodes and ensure edge highlighting is not color-only.
